items.title: PaperCut Exploitation Escalates to Active Intrusions
items.description: CISA has added the vulnerabilities tracked as CVE-2026-82078 and CVE-2026-81578 to its KEV catalog. The post PaperCut Exploitation Escalates to Active Intrusions appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Anthropic Users Hit by Infostealer Attacks, Session Thefts
items.description: A threat actor used a variety of infostealers to collect session information and access Claude accounts belonging to an unknown number of users.
